svg.title: Babul-da tries to stop a bus following the official route into floodwater.
svg.desc: Under a rainless dusk sky, water covers the smart route line and gathers at a blocked drain. A bus follows the official arrow towards it while Babul-da rises on his cycle-van pedals and Cecil reports that the route remains authorised.
svg.text: Page 43, panel 1 · Street-level wide shot along the low lane

text.tspan: Babul-da sees the official route continuing directly

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
